findings.current: He’d stopped and defended those who criticized his Senior Brothers.
findings.defect: The draft makes him defend the critics rather than his Senior Brothers.
findings.rationale: He stops the critics and speaks in defense of his Senior Brothers.
findings.replacement: He’d stood up to those who criticized his Senior Brothers and defended them.
findings.source: 사형들을 비난하는 이들을 막아 세우고 변호했다.

findings.current: a One Annihilation larger than ever before—yet not even half-compressed—
findings.defect: “Compressed” changes the mechanism, and “yet” loses the causal link between its size and its incomplete formation.
findings.rationale: The strike has not yet gathered even halfway because it is so immense.
findings.replacement: a One Annihilation larger than ever before, and therefore not even half-formed,
findings.source: 그 어느 때보다 거대한, 그렇기에 아직 절반도 채 응집되지 못한 일섬

findings.current: gripped what was left of his beloved sword so tightly it seemed ready to break.
findings.defect: The draft omits that only the hilt remains.
findings.rationale: 검자루밖에 남지 않은 specifies the sword’s physical state before his final attack.
findings.replacement: gripped the hilt—all that remained of his beloved sword—so tightly it seemed ready to break.
findings.source: 이제는 검자루밖에 남지 않은 애검을 으스러져라 움켜쥐었다.

findings.current: while the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord’s strike, already flying through the air, slipped through the flash.
findings.defect: “The flash” points back to the distant blast, obscuring that his strike passes through the two opponents’ attacks.
findings.rationale: The preceding streaks are the Black Ghosts’ ax and sword attacks; the shock wave throws them off balance and creates an opening.
findings.replacement: while the Wind-and-Cloud Sword Lord’s strike, already hurtling through the air, slipped between their two streaks of light.
findings.source: 이미 허공을 밟으며 쏘아지던 풍운검군의 일격은 섬광을 비집고 나아갔다는 것.

findings.current: he’d never forgotten those two words: loyalty and honor.
findings.defect: The rendering replaces 情義—the bonds of affection and duty toward others—with abstract personal honor.
findings.rationale: 情義 describes human ties and the obligations they carry, central to his refusal to abandon the allies still fighting.
findings.replacement: he’d never forgotten the bonds of affection and loyalty.
findings.source: 정의(情義)라는 두 글자를 잊은 적은 없었다.

findings.current: His breath, thick with the smell of blood, slowly dispersed.
findings.defect: The draft substitutes the smell of blood for the sweetish smell specified in the source.
findings.rationale: 단내 is a sweetish smell, not the smell of blood.
findings.source: 단내가 풀풀 풍기는 숨결이 느릿하게 흩어진다.

summary: One reversed action and several material errors in the battle mechanics and physical details.
